errors.description: The final response says the worksheet has three pages, but the delivered worksheet renders as five pages.

artifact_findings: Independent interpretation yields 8 full bags, 2 leftovers, 15 vans, 34 whole pieces, 59 cartons, 2 cards on the last page, about 6 buses/37 students, 138 full boxes, 307 shelves/7 books, and 53 boxes/2 marbles.
The same division can appropriately produce a dropped quotient, rounded quotient, or remainder, and the key explains every choice correctly.
rationale: An accurate, well-designed remainder-interpretation set with complete coverage of all multi-part objective answers and an excellent guide. The only issue is an incorrect worksheet page count in the delivery description.
